We have combined subnetworks as given. The simulated resistances match measurements (given measurements list). Let's verify all measurement pairs.

We have measurements list includes many node pairs: A-B, A-N_b1, A-N_b2, A-N_b3, A-X1, B-N_b1, B-N_b2, B-N_b3, B-X1, N_b1-N_b2, N_b1-N_b3, N_b1-X1, N_b2-N_b3, N_b2-X1, N_b3-X1.

We need to ensure our combined topology yields those resistances. We have already simulated A-B, A-N_b1, A-N_b2, A-N_b3. Need also A-X1, B-N_b1, B-N_b2, B-N_b3, B-X1, N_b1-N_b2, N_b1-N_b3, N_b1-X1, N_b2-N_b3, N_b2-X1, N_b3-X1.

Let's simulate remaining.
